name: A song of the drum house
about: Composed for this atlas in the manner of the music of the naqqāra-khāna, the drum house over the gates of Persian palaces and shrines, where shawms, long trumpets and kettledrums greet the dawn and the dusk: a stately tune in dastgāh chahārgāh (D, E flat, F sharp, G, A, B flat, C sharp).
